actualConsumptionCoverage.scope: Two selected receiver pixels and one selected cache lane only; no inference about unobserved scene paths

collection.label: material-mpb-propagation-02
collection.format: R32G32B32A32_SFloat Linear; raw little-endian RGBA32F, unflipped GPU rows
collection.png: Preview only: max(0,RGB)/(1+max(0,RGB)), then LinearToGammaSpace; no row flip
collection.timing: FrameTimingManager whole-frame samples, potentially delayed/repeated, capture/IO contaminated; zero or nonfinite is missing, not GI timing
collection.scope: Collection only; not image quality, successful GI passes, DXR execution, or performance acceptance

observerResult.scope: Finite material propagation evidence; actual contribution coverage is evaluated from recorded winning paths, never inferred from color.

selection.rule: 3x3 identity interior, nearest projected mesh bounds center; raster tie-break; no radiance selection. Cache sorted by full identity and cell, valid prior measurement.
